Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
DOC-0056 2026-10-22
RETROSPECTIVE — The Electrical Reference Missing From
the Carry List
Date: 2026-10-22
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Recorder: PERSON-0022, TEAM-0004
What happened An electrical discussion reference was left out when the
outgoing coordinator recopied the handover carry list. The folder stayed on
the desk shelf, but the incoming clerk's list did not explain its next
administrative contact. ISSUE-0106 and TASK-0283 locate the example used
for this review.
What helped The desk index retained the reference and the appointment diary
retained the promised contact time. Comparing those sources with the carry
list exposed the omission while the outgoing coordinator was still available.
The desk could restore the handover context without inventing a change to the
underlying record.
What changes The incoming clerk will compare the carry list against the desk
index during the handover conversation. Keep the outgoing sheet as a dated
copy rather than replacing it with a cleaned-up version that hides the
omission.
A context strip must stay with the folder, carrying the question, reply
destination, and next contact time. That strip provides a way to resume the
discussion if a copied list drops the reference again. It supplements the list
comparison; it does not excuse skipping it.
Follow-up PERSON-0022 will walk through the index comparison with the
electrical desk clerk on 2026-10-28. The teaching folder will retain the omitted
entry, the correction note, and the context strip so the next shift can follow the
recovery.
D. Worker 0022
Demo Worker 0022, Demo Team 04
